name: Zeeb
overview: Zeeb, identified as a prince of Midian alongside Oreb, appears in Scripture as a defeated enemy of Israel during Gideon's campaign. Judges 7:25 and 8:3 recount how God delivered these Midianite leaders into Israel's hands, highlighting divine sovereignty in their defeat. Psalm 83:11 further memorializes their downfall by invoking their names as examples of vanquished foes, underscoring God's protection over His people against their adversaries.
